primary_source.title: IMO MSC.137(76) Standards for Ship Manoeuvrability

findings.detail: Advance is distance in original course direction until heading change of exactly 90 degrees, not an unspecified change of heading; source Annex 4.2.3.
First overshoot is additional heading deviation after second execute in zig-zag test, not shaft maximum rpm; Annex 4.2.7.
Full astern stopping test measures track reach from full astern order until vessel stops in water; Annex 4.2.10-.11.
Turning ability concerns turning circle advance and tactical diameter, not engine start time; Annex 5.3.1.

remaining_gates: verify exact MAN-966 record in production main
repair imprecise assertion I and III only after production record identity confirmed
